text: Ensuring security is one of the most important parts of web development. First, every website should use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user's browser and the server. This prevents hackers from reading sensitive information like passwords or credit card numbers. Second, developers must implement strong authentication, such as requiring complex passwords and multi-factor verification, to confirm that users are who they claim to be. Additionally, all user input should be validated on the server side to block malicious code. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection or cross-site scripting, can be avoided by filtering and escaping data. By following these practices, developers protect both their users and their websites.
